fullTextEN: Hello everyone.
Teacher Wang is here!
Today,

fullTextZH: 王老师继续给你们讲孙悟空的故事。
fullTextEN: Teacher Wang continues to tell you the story of Sun Wukong.
In the last story,
Tang Monk got another disciple.
Who is he?
What is his name?
That's right, he is Zhu Bajie.
Zhu Bajie is a bit lazy, a bit fat,
a bit greedy, and also a bit cute.

fullTextZH: 虽然猪八戒没有孙悟空那么厉害，
fullTextEN: Although Zhu Bajie is not as powerful as Sun Wukong,

fullTextZH: 但是他也有自己的本领。
fullTextEN: he also has his own skills.
He can fly and also transform.

fullTextZH: 他有自己的武器：九齿钉耙。
fullTextEN: He has his own weapon: the Nine-toothed Rake.

fullTextZH: 他和孙悟空一起保护唐僧去如来家拿书。
fullTextEN: He and Sun Wukong together protect Tang Monk to get scriptures from Tathagata's home.
One more person,
one more helper.
On this day,

fullTextZH: 他们三个人和一匹白龙马，
fullTextEN: the three of them and a white dragon horse,
Walking on the road.
They arrived at a place.
This place is uneven,
Surrounded by mountains.
All trees, all grass,
All stones.
Sun Wukong said to Zhu Bajie:
This place is not safe,
There are many tigers and wolves.

fullTextZH: 你一定要保护好师傅呀！
fullTextEN: You must protect the master well!
Zhu Bajie said: "Don't worry, don't worry,
With me here, no problem!"
Suddenly,
Whoosh! A strong wind blew.
The wind was extremely strong.
Sun Wukong said: "Not good!
There's a monster, quickly protect the master!"

fullTextZH: 说完，从树里面跳出了一只妖怪。
fullTextEN: After speaking, a monster jumped out from the tree.

fullTextZH: 这个妖怪长着老虎的头，
fullTextEN: This monster has a tiger's head,
and a human body.
The tiger walks on four legs,

fullTextZH: 而这个妖怪用两条腿走路。
fullTextEN: but this monster walks on two legs.

fullTextZH: 它是一只老虎变的妖怪。
fullTextEN: It is a monster transformed from a tiger.

fullTextZH: 妖怪站在一块大石头上，大声说：
fullTextEN: The monster stood on a big rock and said loudly:
"Where do you come from?"

fullTextZH: 唐僧害怕极了：“我们从东边来，
fullTextEN: Tang Monk was very scared: "We come from the east,
going to the west to fetch scriptures from Tathagata's place.
Please let us pass!"
The monster prepared to catch Tang Monk.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空拿着金箍棒就要打妖怪。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong, holding the golden cudgel, was about to hit the monster.
Zhu Bajie said: "Elder brother,
you take a rest.
It's just one monster,
I'll go fight him!"

fullTextZH: 猪八戒拿着九齿钉耙和妖怪打起来了。
fullTextEN: Zhu Bajie, holding the nine-toothed rake, started fighting the monster.
Although Zhu Bajie is a bit clumsy,
and also a bit fat,

fullTextZH: 但是比这只妖怪厉害一点。
fullTextEN: he is a bit stronger than this monster.
The monster couldn't take it anymore,

fullTextZH: 变成了一只巨大的老虎。
fullTextEN: and transformed into a giant tiger.
Sun Wukong also came to help.

fullTextZH: 妖怪看到孙悟空那么厉害，
fullTextEN: The monster saw Sun Wukong was so powerful,
and planned to run away.
At this moment, a strong wind blew again.
The wind was very strong,
and nothing could be seen with the eyes.
The monster ran away.
The bad monster ran really fast!

fullTextZH: 孙悟空回来找猪八戒和唐僧。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong returned to find Zhu Bajie and Tang Monk.
The wind just now was too strong,

fullTextZH: 现在猪八戒还趴在地上呢。
fullTextEN: and now Zhu Bajie is still lying on the ground.
But on the White Dragon Horse,
the master was missing!

fullTextZH: 孙悟空问猪八戒：“师傅呢？”
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong asked Zhu Bajie, 'Where is the master?'

fullTextZH: 猪八戒说：“师傅可能去洗手间了吧？”
fullTextEN: Zhu Bajie said, 'The master might have gone to the restroom?'
Sun Wukong was a bit angry.
The wind was so strong,

fullTextZH: 眼睛什么东西都看不见。
fullTextEN: that nothing could be seen with the eyes.
Who would go to the restroom on a windy day?
He must have been taken away by the monster!

fullTextZH: 他们开始在山里面找师傅。
fullTextEN: They started looking for the master in the mountains.

fullTextZH: 他们找了很长很长时间。
fullTextEN: They searched for a very long time.
Finally, they discovered a cave.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空拿着金箍棒大叫：“妖怪，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong held the golden staff and shouted: "Monster,
Quickly give the master back to me!"
He shouted for a long time.
At this moment, the door opened.

fullTextZH: 从里面出来了一群小妖怪。
fullTextEN: A group of little monsters came out from inside.

fullTextZH: 这些小妖怪长得很奇怪，
fullTextEN: These little monsters looked very strange,
small eyes, sharp mouths.
They were monsters transformed from a group of mice.

fullTextZH: 最后出来的这个首领就是那只老虎了。
fullTextEN: The last one to come out was the leader, which was the tiger.

fullTextZH: 妖怪说：“你们的师傅是我今天的午饭，
fullTextEN: The monster said: "Your master is my lunch today,
I will eat him in a while.
You better leave quickly!"
Sun Wukong was very angry after hearing this,
He held the golden staff to fight the monster.

fullTextZH: 这次孙悟空看见妖怪的嘴，
fullTextEN: This time Sun Wukong saw the monster's mouth,
Whoosh~
A strong wind blew again.
The yellow strong wind.
After a while, the wind calmed down.
The monsters all disappeared.

fullTextZH: 可是孙悟空的眼睛看不见了。
fullTextEN: But Sun Wukong's eyes couldn't see.
What to do?
"Bajie, quickly take me to see a doctor!"

fullTextZH: 他们能在这山里面找到医生吗？
fullTextEN: Can they find a doctor in this mountain?
Will Sun Wukong's eyes get better?

fullTextZH: 下次王老师再来告诉你们，再见喽！
fullTextEN: Next time Teacher Wang will tell you again, goodbye!
